name: transcripted
description: Read-only search over the meetings, dictations and writing saved by the Transcripted Mac app.
long_description: Transcripted is a free, open source Mac app that records meetings and dictation and saves them as local Markdown files. This extension lets Claude search and read those files: find what was said, who said it, decisions and action items. It is read-only and runs on your Mac. Audio and transcripts never leave your Mac. Install the Transcripted app first from https://transcripted.app so there is something to search.
